<section class="pys-sema-root" id="semaglutida-en-mexico">
  <style>
    .pys-sema-root{
      --sema-ink:#f5f5f2;
      --sema-graphite:#090a0b;
      --sema-graphite2:#111416;
      --sema-graphite3:#17191b;
      --sema-card:#151719;
      --sema-card2:#202225;
      --sema-muted:#cfd5d2;
      --sema-soft:#aeb8b4;
      --sema-line:rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      --sema-teal:#00e5c4;
      --sema-teal2:#62e8d5;
      --sema-green:#5f9f71;
      --sema-wa:#25D366;
      --sema-shadow:0 28px 72px rgba(0,0,0,.32);
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
      padding:0;
      font-family:"Inter","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
      color:var(--sema-ink);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 10% 14%,rgba(0,229,196,.13),transparent 28%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 88% 10%,rgba(95,159,113,.12),transparent 28%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 52% 60%,rgba(0,229,196,.06),transparent 34%),
        linear-gradient(135deg,#090a0b 0%,#111416 48%,#17191b 100%);
      isolation:isolate;
    }

    .pys-sema-root *{box-sizing:border-box}
    .pys-sema-root a{text-decoration:none!important}

    .pys-sema-wrap{
      width:min(100% - 32px,1180px);
      margin:auto;
      position:relative;
      z-index:3;
    }

    .pys-sema-bgline{
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      pointer-events:none;
      opacity:.24;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px);
      background-size:42px 42px;
      mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(0,0,0,.9),transparent 78%);
      z-index:0;
    }

    .pys-sema-orb{
      position:absolute;
      border-radius:999px;
      pointer-events:none;
      filter:blur(5px);
      opacity:.55;
      z-index:1;
      animation:pysSemaDrift 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    .pys-sema-orb-a{
      width:300px;
      height:300px;
      left:-130px;
      top:210px;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,229,196,.22),transparent 68%);
    }

    .pys-sema-orb-b{
      width:280px;
      height:280px;
      right:-110px;
      top:580px;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(95,159,113,.20),transparent 68%);
      animation-delay:1.6s;
    }

    @keyframes pysSemaDrift{
      from{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1)}
      to{transform:translate3d(24px,-28px,0) scale(1.07)}
    }

    .pys-sema-hero{
      padding:100px 0 62px;
      position:relative;
    }

    .pys-sema-hero-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:.94fr 1.06fr;
      gap:50px;
      align-items:center;
    }

    .pys-sema-badge{
      display:inline-flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:10px;
      padding:11px 16px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
      color:#f5f5f2;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      font-size:.72rem;
      font-weight:950;
      letter-spacing:.12em;
      margin-bottom:24px;
      backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
    }

    .pys-sema-badge:before{
      content:"";
      width:9px;
      height:9px;
      border-radius:50%;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--sema-teal),var(--sema-green));
      box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(0,229,196,.70);
    }

    .pys-sema-title{
      margin:0;
      max-width:790px;
      font-family:"Optima","Optima LT Std","Candara","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
      font-size:clamp(3rem,6.4vw,6.2rem);
      line-height:.9;
      letter-spacing:-.067em;
      font-weight:400;
      color:#ffffff;
    }

    .pys-sema-title span{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00e5c4,#ffffff 48%,#62e8d5);
      -webkit-background-clip:text;
      background-clip:text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
    }

    .pys-sema-copy{
      margin:28px 0 0;
      max-width:720px;
      color:var(--sema-muted);
      line-height:1.86;
      font-size:1.03rem;
    }

    .pys-sema-copy strong{color:#fff}

    .pys-sema-actions{
      display:flex;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
      gap:13px;
      margin-top:30px;
    }

    .pys-sema-btn{
      min-height:54px;
      display:inline-flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:10px;
      padding:15px 25px;
      border-radius:999px;
      border:0;
      cursor:pointer;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:.1em;
      font-size:.72rem;
      font-weight:950;
      transition:.28s ease;
      white-space:nowrap;
    }

    .pys-sema-btn svg{
      width:18px;
      height:18px;
      flex:0 0 18px;
    }

    .pys-sema-btn-primary{
      color:#071211!important;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00e5c4,#62e8d5);
      box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(0,229,196,.22);
    }

    .pys-sema-btn-dark{
      color:#fff!important;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
    }

    .pys-sema-btn-wa{
      color:#06130b!important;
      background:#25D366;
      box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(37,211,102,.18);
    }

    .pys-sema-btn:hover{
      transform:translateY(-4px);
      filter:saturate(1.06);
    }

    .pys-sema-quick{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
      gap:12px;
      margin-top:26px;
      max-width:720px;
    }

    .pys-sema-quick span{
      min-height:66px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:10px;
      padding:14px 15px;
      border-radius:22px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
      color:#f5f5f2;
      font-size:.84rem;
      font-weight:800;
      line-height:1.3;
      backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
    }

    .pys-sema-quick i{
      width:10px;
      height:10px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:var(--sema-teal);
      box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(0,229,196,.72);
      flex:0 0 10px;
    }

    .pys-sema-visual{
      position:relative;
      min-height:570px;
      border-radius:38px;
      overflow:hidden;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 38%,rgba(0,229,196,.16),transparent 42%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 88% 88%,rgba(95,159,113,.11),transparent 36%),
        linear-gradient(145deg,#111416 0%,#202225 100%);
      box-shadow:0 34px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    }

    .pys-sema-visual:before{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      inset:18px;
      border-radius:28px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      pointer-events:none;
      z-index:4;
    }

    .pys-sema-visual:after{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      z-index:2;
      pointer-events:none;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(9,10,11,.70) 0%,rgba(9,10,11,.18) 34%,rgba(9,10,11,.10) 66%,rgba(9,10,11,.55) 100%),
        linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(9,10,11,.28) 0%,rgba(9,10,11,.05) 45%,rgba(9,10,11,.55) 100%);
      mix-blend-mode:multiply;
    }

    .pys-sema-hero-img{
      position:absolute;
      inset:0;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      object-fit:cover;
      z-index:1;
      transform:scale(1.02);
      filter:saturate(.96) contrast(1.05) brightness(.82);
      animation:pysSemaBreath 7s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pysSemaBreath{
      0%,100%{transform:scale(1.02)}
      50%{transform:scale(1.07)}
    }

    .pys-sema-visual-card{
      position:absolute;
      left:24px;
      bottom:24px;
      width:min(360px,calc(100% - 48px));
      padding:22px;
      border-radius:26px;
      background:rgba(12,16,17,.74);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
      box-shadow:0 22px 54px rgba(0,0,0,.34);
      backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
      z-index:5;
    }

    .pys-sema-visual-card h3{
      margin:0 0 10px;
      color:#62e8d5;
      font-size:.86rem;
      letter-spacing:.12em;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      font-weight:950;
    }

    .pys-sema-visual-card p{
      margin:0;
      color:#d4d9d7;
      line-height:1.65;
      font-size:.93rem;
    }

    .pys-sema-section{
      padding:64px 0;
      position:relative;
      z-index:2;
    }

    .pys-sema-section-soft{
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.02),rgba(255,255,255,0)),
        linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.015),rgba(255,255,255,0));
    }

    .pys-sema-head{
      max-width:880px;
      margin-bottom:34px;
    }

    .pys-sema-tag{
      display:inline-flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:10px;
      color:#62e8d5;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      font-weight:950;
      font-size:.72rem;
      letter-spacing:.12em;
      margin-bottom:16px;
    }

    .pys-sema-tag:before{
      content:"";
      width:9px;
      height:9px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--sema-teal),var(--sema-green));
      box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(0,229,196,.70);
    }

    .pys-sema-section-title{
      margin:0;
      max-width:960px;
      font-family:"Optima","Optima LT Std","Candara","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
      font-size:clamp(2.05rem,4vw,4.1rem);
      line-height:1;
      letter-spacing:-.055em;
      font-weight:400;
      color:#ffffff;
    }

    .pys-sema-section-title span{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00e5c4,#ffffff);
      -webkit-background-clip:text;
      background-clip:text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;
    }

    .pys-sema-section-copy{
      margin:22px 0 0;
      color:var(--sema-muted);
      line-height:1.86;
      font-size:1.01rem;
    }

    .pys-sema-compact-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:1.06fr .94fr;
      gap:24px;
      align-items:stretch;
    }

    .pys-sema-panel{
      border-radius:32px;
      padding:34px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left,rgba(0,229,196,.08),transparent 32%),
        linear-gradient(145deg,#151719 0%,#202225 100%);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      box-shadow:0 24px 58px rgba(0,0,0,.24);
      backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
      transition:.28s ease;
    }

    .pys-sema-panel:before{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      width:220px;
      height:220px;
      right:-90px;
      bottom:-100px;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,229,196,.12),transparent 68%);
      border-radius:999px;
      pointer-events:none;
    }

    .pys-sema-panel:hover{
      transform:translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.30);
      border-color:rgba(0,229,196,.24);
    }

    .pys-sema-panel > *{
      position:relative;
      z-index:2;
    }

    .pys-sema-panel h3{
      margin:0 0 14px;
      color:#ffffff;
      font-size:1.28rem;
      letter-spacing:-.025em;
    }

    .pys-sema-panel p{
      margin:0;
      color:#cfd5d2;
      line-height:1.78;
      font-size:.96rem;
    }

    .pys-sema-icon{
      width:62px;
      height:62px;
      margin-bottom:20px;
      border-radius:22px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      color:#071211;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00e5c4,#62e8d5);
      box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,229,196,.20);
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
    }

    .pys-sema-icon:after{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      inset:-40%;
      background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.45),transparent);
      transform:rotate(35deg) translateX(-130%);
      animation:pysSemaIconShine 5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pysSemaIconShine{
      0%,62%{transform:rotate(35deg) translateX(-130%)}
      82%,100%{transform:rotate(35deg) translateX(130%)}
    }

    .pys-sema-icon svg{
      position:relative;
      z-index:2;
      width:30px;
      height:30px;
      fill:none;
      stroke:currentColor;
      stroke-width:2;
      stroke-linecap:round;
      stroke-linejoin:round;
    }

    .pys-sema-tabs{
      border-radius:36px;
      overflow:hidden;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left,rgba(0,229,196,.08),transparent 32%),
        linear-gradient(145deg,#151719 0%,#202225 100%);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      box-shadow:0 24px 58px rgba(0,0,0,.24);
      backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
    }

    .pys-sema-tab-nav{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
      gap:0;
      background:#101314;
      border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    }

    .pys-sema-tab-btn{
      border:0;
      cursor:pointer;
      padding:19px 14px;
      background:transparent;
      color:#d4d9d7;
      font:inherit;
      font-size:.76rem;
      font-weight:950;
      letter-spacing:.09em;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      transition:.25s ease;
      border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
    }

    .pys-sema-tab-btn:last-child{border-right:0}

    .pys-sema-tab-btn.is-active{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00e5c4,#62e8d5);
      color:#071211;
      box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(0,229,196,.18);
    }

    .pys-sema-tab-content{
      display:none;
      padding:34px;
    }

    .pys-sema-tab-content.is-active{
      display:block;
      animation:pysSemaFade .35s ease both;
    }

    @keyframes pysSemaFade{
      from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}
      to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
    }

    .pys-sema-tab-content h3{
      margin:0 0 14px;
      color:#ffffff;
      font-size:1.45rem;
      letter-spacing:-.035em;
    }

    .pys-sema-tab-content p{
      margin:0 0 16px;
      color:#cfd5d2;
      line-height:1.82;
    }

    .pys-sema-list{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
      gap:12px;
      margin-top:20px;
    }

    .pys-sema-list span{
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:10px;
      min-height:52px;
      padding:13px 14px;
      border-radius:18px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);
      color:#f5f5f2;
      font-size:.9rem;
      line-height:1.35;
      font-weight:750;
    }

    .pys-sema-list span:before{
      content:"";
      width:8px;
      height:8px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:var(--sema-teal);
      box-shadow:0 0 13px rgba(0,229,196,.55);
      flex:0 0 8px;
    }

    .pys-sema-props{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
      gap:16px;
    }

    .pys-sema-prop{
      padding:24px;
      border-radius:28px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left,rgba(0,229,196,.08),transparent 32%),
        linear-gradient(145deg,#151719 0%,#202225 100%);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      box-shadow:0 24px 58px rgba(0,0,0,.24);
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
      transition:.28s ease;
    }

    .pys-sema-prop:hover{
      transform:translateY(-5px);
      border-color:rgba(0,229,196,.24);
      box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.30);
    }

    .pys-sema-prop:after{
      content:"";
      position:absolute;
      right:-48px;
      bottom:-54px;
      width:120px;
      height:120px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(0,229,196,.12),transparent 70%);
    }

    .pys-sema-prop strong{
      position:relative;
      z-index:2;
      display:block;
      margin-bottom:10px;
      color:#ffffff;
      font-size:1.02rem;
    }

    .pys-sema-prop span{
      position:relative;
      z-index:2;
      display:block;
      color:#cfd5d2;
      line-height:1.65;
      font-size:.92rem;
    }

    .pys-sema-product-row{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;
      gap:28px;
      align-items:center;
    }

    .pys-sema-product-card{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:190px 1fr;
      gap:22px;
      align-items:center;
      overflow:hidden;
      border-radius:34px;
      background:#15191b;
      color:#fff;
      box-shadow:0 28px 76px rgba(0,0,0,.32);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      transition:.28s ease;
    }

    .pys-sema-product-card:hover{
      transform:translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow:0 34px 86px rgba(0,0,0,.38);
    }

    .pys-sema-product-img{
      min-height:270px;
      height:100%;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      padding:26px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left,rgba(0,229,196,.28),transparent 36%),
        radial-gradient(circle at bottom right,rgba(98,232,213,.18),transparent 34%),
        linear-gradient(145deg,#ffffff,#edf5f2);
    }

    .pys-sema-product-img img{
      width:100%;
      max-width:155px;
      max-height:230px;
      object-fit:contain;
      filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18));
      transition:.28s ease;
    }

    .pys-sema-product-card:hover img{
      transform:scale(1.04) rotate(-1deg);
    }

    .pys-sema-product-body{
      padding:28px 28px 28px 0;
    }

    .pys-sema-product-label{
      display:inline-flex;
      padding:8px 12px;
      border-radius:999px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);
      color:#dffaf5;
      font-size:.62rem;
      font-weight:950;
      letter-spacing:.1em;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      margin-bottom:14px;
    }

    .pys-sema-product-body h3{
      margin:0 0 12px;
      color:#fff;
      font-size:1.62rem;
      line-height:1.08;
      letter-spacing:-.04em;
    }

    .pys-sema-product-body p{
      margin:0 0 20px;
      color:#cdd8d5;
      line-height:1.7;
      font-size:.94rem;
    }

    .pys-sema-product-link{
      display:inline-flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:9px;
      color:#62e8d5!important;
      font-size:.72rem;
      text-transform:uppercase;
      letter-spacing:.1em;
      font-weight:950;
    }

    .pys-sema-product-link:after{
      content:"→";
      font-size:1rem;
      color:#fff;
    }

    .pys-sema-accordion{
      display:grid;
      gap:12px;
    }

    .pys-sema-faq-item{
      border-radius:22px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left,rgba(0,229,196,.08),transparent 32%),
        linear-gradient(145deg,#151719 0%,#202225 100%);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      box-shadow:0 24px 58px rgba(0,0,0,.24);
      overflow:hidden;
    }

    .pys-sema-faq-btn{
      width:100%;
      border:0;
      background:transparent;
      color:#ffffff;
      padding:20px 22px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:18px;
      text-align:left;
      cursor:pointer;
      font:inherit;
      font-weight:950;
      letter-spacing:-.015em;
    }

    .pys-sema-faq-plus{
      width:32px;
      height:32px;
      border-radius:999px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      flex:0 0 32px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      color:#62e8d5;
      transition:.25s ease;
    }

    .pys-sema-faq-plus:before{
      content:"+";
      font-size:1.25rem;
      line-height:1;
      font-weight:700;
    }

    .pys-sema-faq-item.is-open .pys-sema-faq-plus{
      transform:rotate(45deg);
      background:#62e8d5;
      color:#071211;
    }

    .pys-sema-faq-panel{

    (function(){
      var root = document.querySelector('.pys-sema-root');
      if(!root) return;

      var reveals = root.querySelectorAll('.pys-sema-reveal');

      if('IntersectionObserver' in window){
        var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
          entries.forEach(function(entry){
            if(entry.isIntersecting){
              entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
              io.unobserve(entry.target);
            }
          });
        }, { threshold: 0.14 });

        reveals.forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
      } else {
        reveals.forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('is-visible'); });
      }

      var tabButtons = root.querySelectorAll('.pys-sema-tab-btn');
      var tabContents = root.querySelectorAll('.pys-sema-tab-content');

      tabButtons.forEach(function(btn){
        btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
          var tab = btn.getAttribute('data-sema-tab');

          tabButtons.forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('is-active'); });
          tabContents.forEach(function(c){ c.classList.remove('is-active'); });

          btn.classList.add('is-active');
          var target = root.querySelector('[data-sema-content="'+tab+'"]');
          if(target) target.classList.add('is-active');
        });
      });

      var faqItems = root.querySelectorAll('.pys-sema-faq-item');

      faqItems.forEach(function(item){
        var btn = item.querySelector('.pys-sema-faq-btn');
        var panel = item.querySelector('.pys-sema-faq-panel');

        btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
          var open = item.classList.contains('is-open');

          faqItems.forEach(function(other){
            var otherPanel = other.querySelector('.pys-sema-faq-panel');
            other.classList.remove('is-open');
            otherPanel.style.maxHeight = null;
          });

          if(!open){
            item.classList.add('is-open');
            panel.style.maxHeight = panel.scrollHeight + 'px';
          }
        });
      });
    })();
  </script>
